prompt:
Use case: logo-brand / stylized app icon.
Create a single premium mobile app icon foreground artwork for HEXDROP, a playful dark alchemy app. Transparent background, square 1024x1024 composition, no text and no border or rounded-square tile.

One beautifully designed, very legible magical potion bottle, bold compact silhouette, occupying about 70% of the canvas with generous transparent margins on all sides. The bottle stands upright, slightly tilted clockwise by 10 degrees, with a broad softly faceted hexagonal body, short narrow neck, and a striking small geometric emerald crystal stopper held in a warm antique gold rim. Translucent smoky mint glass, filled two thirds with vivid luminous acid-lime green potion (#b5f564), deeper saturated emerald at its base; visible curling fluid ribbon and two small suspended bubbles inside. An elegant white-green reflection down the upper-left glass bevel. A tiny charcoal spider with just a small coral-red diamond marking perched on the upper-right shoulder/neck, legs forming a clear readable silhouette. One crisp four-point pale lime sparkle beside the bottle at upper left. Keep these details subordinate to the strong bottle silhouette.

Style: polished stylized 3D object, restrained game-item meets boutique macOS app icon craft, crisp faceted geometry and soft bevels, deliberate shapes, beautiful material contrast, meticulously lit. Not photographic, not flat clipart, not cluttered fantasy concept art. No floor, no drop shadow stretching beyond the object, no environment. Green inner light with warm gold highlights; designed to sit on solid nearly-black plum #0a090e. Any glow is subtle and stays close to the object. Fully transparent outer background. No typography, letters, watermark, extra bottles, plants, moons or decorative frame. The tiny spider is friendly, not scary.
exports: Generated by scripts/generate-icons.cjs; opaque iOS icons, Android adaptive/monochrome layers, and shared launch artwork.
